text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired: notify-proxy latency spike -> attempted page for svc-payments (severity: P1). Delivery status: 1/3 endpoints failed, 2 suppressed.
alex: Did we page the oncall? I don't see any ack in #oncall-sre. anyone oncall?
oncall-sre-shift4: I didn't get a page. only saw a message in #ops-war-room.
maria: I'm looking at the notify-bridge logs now, seems the routing tag for svc-payments was missing after a config roll earlier today. bridge returned 204 for the webhook but downstream route selection returned empty -> treated as suppressed.
sam: Wow. so the bot thought it delivered but the mapping was empty. initiating manual SMS to oncall now. /run escalate --sms oncall-sre-shift4
alex: Thanks. Can you paste the error snippet from the bridge logs?
maria: log excerpt:
```
2024-11-03T14:12:31Z INFO bridge: received alert {service: svc-payments}
2024-11-03T14:12:31Z WARN bridge: route-resolver returned empty for tag=payments-prod
2024-11-03T14:12:31Z INFO bridge: mark delivery=suppressed reason="no-route"
```
maria: And the webhook response to incident-bot was 204 which made it look successful. we didn't have a hard fail.
emily: Who deployed the notify-routing change today? any recent PRs? @maria can you grep for merges around 13:50?
maria: found PR #3225 merged by @lee at 13:46 that cleaned up routing logic; a unit test missed the edge-case where tag lookup falls back to empty list.
sam: Rolling back that release to restore previous route resolution. rolling rollback now.
incident-bot: rollback-triggered by sam at 14:16 UTC, started deployment job 9876.
alex: Manual SMS confirmed delivered, oncall ACK incoming.
oncall-sre-shift4: ACKed, investigating local impact and customer reports.
emily: Once rollback is green, can we add a hard fail metric (bridge.route.empty -> alert) so suppressed deliveries become visible?
maria: yes, I'll open a follow-up patch to add a metric and a unit test—also adding a CI check to run route lookups against current mapping fixture.
alex: Good, please also add a short postmortem doc and tag ops-runbook. we had customer-facing errors for ~7m before manual escalation.
sam: Postmortem draft coming in #postmortems in ~30m. sequence: config PR -> routing flip -> route empty -> suppressed deliveries -> manual SMS -> rollback.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: delivery path restored. final note: created ticket OPS-512 to track follow-ups.
